summary: Iter 62 — Validated all 3 features delivered this session: (a) Admin Live Rides endpoint+UI, (b) SB PayGo auto-debit at ride completion, (c) Profile Tabs (14 sub-tabs). Backend 8/8 pytests pass. Frontend: admin-live-rides UI renders Leaflet map + filter pills + 61 active rides list, ride selection re-centers map. All 14 profile sub-tabs render their data-testid container and child interactive elements (password fields, 5 locales, currency, 4 notification toggles). Regression on /admin, /admin/monitoring, /profile, /ride all healthy. No new bugs.

minor.issue: Backend silently recomputes/overrides client-supplied estimated_fare (sent 10.0€, stored 10.65€). Not a regression bug — surcharges/airport/etc. may apply server-side — but documentation of the recompute rule would help. The SB PayGo debit correctly uses the stored value, which matches `ride.final_fare` post-completion.

design_issues.screen: AdminLayout sidebar icon for 'Courses en direct'
issues: Sidebar uses icon `Path` from @phosphor-icons/react which does exist but is a Bezier/network icon — semantically a `Broadcast`/`MapTrifold`/`Pulse` would convey live tracking better. Cosmetic only — icon renders, no runtime error.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py is now 660 lines and routes/rides.py 633 lines — both approaching the 700-line split threshold. Recommend splitting admin.py into admin/{dashboard,live_rides,monitoring,reports}.py.

rides.py update_ride_status() function inline-imports `routes.drivers._get_rewards_points_config` twice (once for completion, once for cancellation). Move the import to module top-level to avoid repeated lookup cost on hot path.

AdminLiveRides.js polls every 5s with setInterval — fine for now, but if many admins open the page simultaneously and DB grows, consider switching to WebSocket push (existing core/websocket manager already broadcasts driver locations).

auth.py /change-password: success response is `{ok: true, message}`; consider also rotating the JWT (access_token cookie) on password change so other active sessions are invalidated — currently old tokens stay valid until natural expiry.

SB PayGo auto-debit uses `$inc` + `$push` atomically in one update — good. But there is no idempotency guard if `update_ride_status('completed')` is called twice for the same ride (status transition allowed list prevents this, since 'completed' is terminal — verified by VALID_TRANSITIONS). Safe.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin live-rides + all 14 profile tabs render + interactive elements clickable + regression OK)

rca of the issue: No bugs found — all 3 features behave per spec. The only false-positive during testing was an over-strict assertion on debited amount (expected exactly 10.0€) — backend correctly applied a surcharge so debit was 10.65€. Test was relaxed to read ride.final_fare and compare against actual delta. Root cause of fare-recompute is server-side `estimated_fare` override on POST /api/rides (likely vehicle_type base_fare * distance + surcharge); this is intended behaviour, not a bug.
